MalfurionEntanglingRootsDeepRootsTalent.name: Deep Roots
MalfurionEntanglingRootsDeepRootsTalent.description: Entangling Roots grows 25% larger, and persist on the ground 40% longer. Repeatable Quest: Every time an enemy Hero becomes Rooted, gain 14 Mana permanently.

MalfurionMasteryVengefulRoots.name: Vengeful Roots
MalfurionMasteryVengefulRoots.description: Entangling Roots spawns a Treant that deals 58 damage per second and lasts 10 seconds. Repeatable Quest: Hitting enemy Heroes with Entangling Roots permanently increases the Treant's Basic Attack damage by 7.

MalfurionEntanglingRootsEmeraldDreams.name: Emerald Dreams
MalfurionEntanglingRootsEmeraldDreams.description: Entangling Roots Sleeps enemy Heroes for 2 seconds after its Root expires.

MalfurionRejuvenation.name: Rejuvenation
MalfurionRejuvenation.description: Casting Regrowth on an ally also grants Malfurion its effect for 50% normal duration.

MalfurionCelestialAlignment.name: Celestial Alignment
MalfurionCelestialAlignment.description: Increase Moonfire's reveal duration by 3 seconds. Malfurion's Basic Attacks against Heroes revealed by Moonfire deal 85% more damage.

MalfurionCombatStyleShandosClarity.name: Shan'do's Clarity
MalfurionCombatStyleShandosClarity.description: Gain a second charge of Innervate. Its cooldown recharges 25% faster per ally affected by Regrowth.

MalfurionWildGrowthTalent.name: Wild Growth
MalfurionWildGrowthTalent.description: Each Hero hit by Moonfire extends the duration of currently active Regrowths by 1 second.

MalfurionMasteryTenaciousRootsEntangling.name: Tenacious Roots
MalfurionMasteryTenaciousRootsEntangling.description: Increase the Root duration of Entangling Roots by 25%. When Malfurion is Stunned, the cooldown of Entangling Roots is instantly reset. This can only occur every 10 seconds.

MalfurionNaturesCureRegrowth.name: Nature's Cure
MalfurionNaturesCureRegrowth.description: Activate to remove all Stuns, Roots, and Slows from allies affected by Regrowth.

MalfurionHeroicAbilityTranquility.name: Tranquility
MalfurionHeroicAbilityTranquility.description: Heal nearby allied Heroes for 80 (+4% per level) Health per second for 8 seconds. Allies affected by Regrowth within Tranquility's area gain 10 Armor.

MalfurionHeroicAbilityTwilightDream.name: Twilight Dream
MalfurionHeroicAbilityTwilightDream.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310 (+4% per level) damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.

MalfurionRegrowthNaturesSwiftness.name: Nature's Swiftness
MalfurionRegrowthNaturesSwiftness.description: Malfurion gains 6% Movement Speed for every active Regrowth.

MalfurionMasteryHinderingMoonfire.name: Hindering Moonfire
MalfurionMasteryHinderingMoonfire.description: Moonfire Slows Heroes hit by 25% for 3 seconds.

MalfurionRevitalizeInnervateTalent.name: Revitalize
MalfurionRevitalizeInnervateTalent.description: Using Innervate also grants Malfurion 15% of his max Mana and causes his Basic Ability cooldowns to refresh 50% faster for 5 seconds.

MalfurionYserasGift.name: Ysera's Gift
MalfurionYserasGift.description: While Malfurion is above 75% Health, Regrowth's healing-over-time is increased by 75%.

MalfurionRegrowthNaturesBalance.name: Nature's Balance
MalfurionRegrowthNaturesBalance.description: Increase Moonfire's area by 25% and Regrowth's duration by 5 seconds.

MalfurionMoonfireMoonlitHarmonyTalent.name: Moonlit Harmony
MalfurionMoonfireMoonlitHarmonyTalent.description: Increase Moonfire's heal by 20%, and 15% per ally affected by Regrowth.

MalfurionMasterySerenity.name: Serenity
MalfurionMasterySerenity.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Moonfire reduces the cooldown of Tranquility by 3 seconds. Increase Tranquility's healing by 25% and 10% per ally affected by Regrowth.

MalfurionMasteryAstralCommunion.name: Astral Communion
MalfurionMasteryAstralCommunion.description: Activate to Channel for 1 second, and then instantly teleport and cast Twilight Dream at the targeted location. Cooldown is shared with Twilight Dream. Passive: Increase Twilight Dream's Silence duration to 5 seconds.

MalfurionLifebloomRegrowth.name: Lifebloom
MalfurionLifebloomRegrowth.description: Casting Regrowth instantly heals its target for 10% of their missing Health.

MalfurionMasteryLunarShower.name: Lunar Shower
MalfurionMasteryLunarShower.description: If Moonfire hits a Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second and the next Moonfire within 6 seconds deals 20% more damage. This damage bonus stacks up to 60%.
